home.noEvent: No tombola is open right now.

landing.heroTitle: Welcome to the Rotaract IUGB Club tombola
landing.heroLede: Log in, buy a ticket, pay at the club, then follow the draw. One account for every club tombola.
landing.step1Text: Register once. The same account follows you from one tombola to the next: ceremonies, meetings, and other club events.
landing.step2Text: Choose how many tickets you want. Numbers are assigned at random, only when an organizer confirms payment.
landing.step3Text: Cash at the club, or Wave. Only paid tickets enter the draw.
landing.step4Text: The organizer chooses the format: scratch tickets, or a public wheel that everyone watches.
landing.donateText: You can also donate via Wave. Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club, receives the payments.

sales.preRegisterLead: Create your account now. Ticket sales open soon.

buy.title: Buy tickets
buy.intro: Log in, then buy. Pay in cash or via Wave. Tickets, with a random number, appear only when the club confirms payment.
buy.introScratch: The club assigns prizes to ticket numbers on the wheel when the tombola is created. As soon as payment is confirmed, scratch to see if yours has one.
buy.introRoulette: The draw is public, on the wheel: everyone sees who wins.
buy.needAccount: Create an account or log in to buy tickets. The same account follows every club tombola.
buy.name: Name
buy.paymentMethod: How do you want to pay?

confirm.title: Order saved
confirm.saveLink: Find your tickets again under My tombolas, after logging in.
confirm.waitingTickets: Your numbers appear here once an organizer confirms payment. You then get a receipt by email.
confirm.notYours: These tickets are not on this account.
confirm.notYoursHelp: Log in with the account that bought them, or open My tombolas.
confirm.statusPaid: Paid. Your tickets are in the draw
confirm.cancelBody: Cancel this order? The tickets go back into the pool. If you already paid on Wave, contact the club with the transaction ID for a refund.
confirm.cancelPaid: The club has already confirmed payment. Contact an organizer.
confirm.cancelLocked: The draw has already happened. This order can no longer be cancelled.

share.title: Give tickets
share.lead: Send one or more paid tickets to someone. They leave your account and appear on theirs. Not possible after the draw.
share.sent: Tickets sent. They will get an email.
share.self: You cannot give tickets to yourself.
share.unpaid: Wait until payment is confirmed to give tickets.

pay.waveHint: Pay Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club, in Wave.
pay.cashHint: Pay an organizer in person at the club.
pay.waveLead: Pay Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club, with Wave. Then copy the transaction ID and paste it below.
pay.waveIdHelp: After paying, copy the ID from Wave and paste it here. It appears on the organizer’s buyers list so they can match your payment.
pay.waveIdSaved: ID sent. The organizer can see it on your row.
pay.waveIdInvalid: Check the ID you copied from Wave.
pay.waveIdLocked: This order can no longer receive an ID.
pay.cashLead: Pay your tickets in cash to a club organizer. Give your name so they can mark the order as paid.
pay.affiliate: Doaty Délice is affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club.

donate.title: Donate
donate.lede: Support the club’s work. Donations go through Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club.
donate.waveText: Open Wave and pay Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club. Choose any amount you wish to give.
donate.cashText: You can also give cash to a club organizer.
donate.refHelp: After paying, copy the transaction ID from Wave, enter the amount, and send it to the club. The organizer sees it under Donations.
donate.sent: Reference sent. The organizer can see it under Donations.
donate.invalid: Check the name, amount, and Wave ID.

scratch.instruction: Scratch the silver panel. The prize, if any, was assigned to this number on the wheel when the tombola was created.
scratch.howto: The club assigns prizes to ticket numbers on the wheel when the tombola is created. When payment is confirmed, scratch to see if yours has one. Your tickets stay here unless an organizer removes them.

deck.hintScratch: Scratch the silver panel. Swipe or use the buttons to change ticket. Nothing is lost.
deck.hintRoulette: Swipe or use the buttons to change ticket. Nothing is lost.
deck.done: You have seen all your tickets.

ticket.howto: Your tickets have a number. The draw is public, on the wheel: everyone sees who wins.

results.title: The draw
results.empty: The draw has not taken place yet.
results.scratchHidden: Prizes were assigned to ticket numbers on the wheel when the tombola was created. Scratch yours. The winners list is not shown here.

admin.drawWarn: Some orders are still unpaid. They will be left out of the draw.
admin.drawHelp: Only paid tickets take part. The first ticket drawn wins 1st prize, the second wins 2nd prize, and so on. This cannot be undone.
admin.noPaid: No paid tickets: the draw cannot run.
admin.needPrizes: Add at least one prize before opening sales.

auth.loginLead: Log in to buy tickets and keep every tombola in one place: ceremonies, meetings, and other club events.
auth.registerLead: One account for every club tombola. Two short steps, and you are in the game.
auth.step1Lead: Photo, name, and the password that opens your tickets.
auth.step2Lead: Tell us where you come from. The tombola likes to know who is in the room.
auth.name: Name
auth.forgotLead: Enter the email of your account. If it exists, you will receive a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists with this email, a link has just been sent. It expires in one hour.
auth.resetLead: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.
auth.termsTitle: General terms of use, participation and sale of tombolas
auth.acceptTerms: I have carefully read the General Terms of Use, Participation and Sale of Tombolas of Rotaract Club IUGB. I acknowledge that I have understood them and I accept without reservation the provisions that apply to me. I acknowledge in particular that reserving a ticket does not constitute payment, that only tickets that have actually been paid and validated take part in the draw, that the result depends on the draw mechanism provided for the tombola, and that a ticket may confer no prize.
auth.acceptEmails: I agree that Rotaract Club IUGB may use my email address to send me communications relating to its tombolas, events, invitations, fundraising and news.

terms.officialNote: The official and binding version of this document is in French. The text below is the French original.

account.title: My tombolas
account.lede: Here are all the tombolas you have joined: ceremony, meeting, or another club event.
account.empty: You do not have tickets yet. Buy some for the current tombola: they will show up here once payment is confirmed.
account.emailLocked: Email is how you log in. It cannot be changed here.
account.verifyLead: A link was sent. Confirm the address so gifted tickets can attach to this account.
account.verifySent: Link sent again. Check your inbox.

pwa.installText: Add the tombola to your home screen to open it like an app.
pwa.installIos: On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa.notifyText: Get an alert when a payment is confirmed, when someone sends you tickets, or when the draw is closed.
pwa.notifyAccount: Notifications follow your tickets: payment confirmed, gifted tickets, and when the draw closes.
pwa.notifyIos: On iPhone, add the app to your home screen first to enable notifications.
pwa.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
pwa.unavailable: Notifications are not available on this device.
pwa.subscribeFailed: Could not enable notifications on this device. Try again from the installed app.
pwa.testSent: A test was sent. It should appear right away.
